notes: Temporary Chat is now available from every regular chat and is never added to history
Work chats have a distinct animated project identity and persistent project badge
Workspace Files displays the real files from the active Work folder and opens supported files for inspection
Work requests can use compact project-only memory from earlier chats in the same project
Each selected project receives a portable .nova-work folder containing project identity, Work chat history, and activity metadata
Opening the same project folder on another Nova installation restores its portable Work history
Portable project metadata is protected against symbolic-link path escapes
